profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Accomplished Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience designing and implementing innovative solutions to challenging technical problems.

Extensive experience throughout the entire development lifecycle: analysis, design, implementation, testing, and post-production support.

Proven expertise in delivering high-quality production level software.

Excellent technical management and leadership skills: proactive, results-oriented, and motivated to succeed.

projects.title: fragmentarium – Digital Research Laboratory for Medieval Manuscript Fragments
projects.description: Fragmentarium enables libraries, collectors, researchers and students to publish images of medieval manuscript fragments, allowing them to catalogue, describe, transcribe, assemble and re-use them.

projects.title: e-codices – Virtual Manuscript Library of Switzerland
projects.description: e-codices provide free access to all medieval and a selection of modern manuscripts of Switzerland by means of a virtual library.
